name: Figure_1
source: Manuscript1, Figure 1
changes: Aligned SEM images and EDS maps; calibrated EDS scale bars; matched Raman/XPS frames and type; no arbitrary y ticks or upper/right ticks.

name: Figure_2
source: Manuscript1, Figure 2
changes: Common chart-body sizes, rebuilt axes, uniform Arial labels; wide cross-response trace spans two columns; synchronized outputs remain stacked.

name: Figure_3
source: Manuscript1, Figure 3a–k
changes: Uniform quantitative axes and contour sizes; contour color bars preserve the source scale; original 3D surface retained.

name: Figure_4
source: Manuscript1, Figure 4
changes: Uniform heatmap grid and condition labels; original map pixels/colors and legends retained; confusion matrices reconstructed from printed counts, and accuracies computed from those counts.
